title: Draft not landed: the head moved
description: DES-CHAT-ARTIFACTS-001 §6.2 (slice I1): a draft.completed named expect_head, the document's head was a different version, and nothing landed. Emitted once per refused landing.

run_id.description: The run_id the draft.completed carried, or null when it carried none.

expect_head.description: The head the run worked from.

actual_head.description: The head the document had when the draft arrived.

project_id.description: The crew project this doc is bound to (derived by the service, as on every service emit). Absent for unbound docs.
